name: beads-storage
title: Beads is the first storage adapter for CoBuilder programs, epics, and slices
outcome: A tracker port sits between CoBuilder and the task system, and beads is its first adapter. Programs, epics, slices, and pull requests live in one proposed central store, which no test verifies yet. The same data/index.json serves the viewer, and one next-ready call answers what is next.
done_when: a seeded tracker holds every program, epic, slice, and pull request with its envelope, and run-time counts match the current index
shared/build_index.py gives a byte-comparable data/index.json through the projector, and a byte compare of the viewer index.html shows no viewer change
the files adapter alone projects to the current data/index.json offline, with no bd installed
next_ready(kind, under) returns the ready records of one kind, and on beads, closing slice n-1 makes slice n appear in bd ready
a pull request issue blocks each epic it holds until a human closes it. Gates 1 to 4, 2b, and 4a to 4c are scalar fields on the program issue
tracker.py exits 2 on a write with no configured adapter, and a grep check finds no call to bd outside shared/tracker_port/
a second clone runs bd sync and sees the same programs, epics, and slices
a test removes the file sources. Then one list-programs call names a program and its stage, and one next-ready call names the next slice, with zero file reads
an envelope round trip compares every value and every list item, and not only the keys
goal.json epics[] carries no branch, pr, or state in any design, and a test checks it
the fake adapter passes the same contract test as the beads adapter
a record list from the fake adapter projects to the same index as the beads one
the contract test and the projector tests read only checked-in fixtures in tests/fixtures/tracker/, and no test reads the live plans
tracker.py has one subcommand for each port operation plus doctor. Over the fake adapter it prints JSON and exits 4 on bad arguments
the reference shared/tracker-usage.md exists, and the main SKILL.md of architect, implement, pr, and artifact link it
every tracker.py operation that a skill, command, or reference names is a subcommand that tracker.py --help lists
no skill, command, or reference outside the beads adapter notes names a bd command, and the reference is in AUTHORING_REFERENCES
abort_if: the metadata envelope cannot round-trip through bd create, bd update, bd export, and bd list --json without loss
the index rebuild reads anything but a local database, a file, or an adapter cache, or it needs GitHub credentials. A later Linear or Jira adapter may use the network
the mapping needs a second custom type beyond program, which would mean the built-in vocabulary was misread
the port needs a method that only one tracker can implement, and no capability flag can cover it

min_work.note: The mapping passed a smoke test against bd 1.3.0 in a scratch tracker. A second test on 2026-10-17 also passed: one pull request issue blocked two epics until bd close, and flat gate fields survived bd show. The engineer chose the tracker port that day. Not verified, and required before E2 closes: a clone-only cloud session that runs bd init and bd sync against refs/dolt/data. The Linear and Jira rows and bd claim are also not verified. Draft review rounds 1 and 2 returned rework and concerns, and the engineer ruled the second set cosmetic.

epics.title: The port: shared/tracker_port/ holds the neutral TrackerRecord and the TrackerPort with its capabilities. It also holds the one projector, the fake adapter, a read-only files adapter, and one contract test. Checked-in fixtures in tests/fixtures/tracker/ feed the fake adapter and the tests. It also holds the tracker CLI shared/tracker.py over the fake and files adapters, and the shared reference shared/tracker-usage.md. E1 ships alone, and its projector matches data/index.json offline.
epics.outcome: A caller reads and writes workflow state through one port, and the fake and files adapters pass the contract test.

epics.title: The beads adapter and seed-from-files. The beads adapter implements the port operation seed-from-files, which creates programs, epics, slices, and pull request issues by external_ref. It only creates, and it covers every plan with a 04-slices.md and the status-only plan skill-collision-fix. It runs bd init with --skip-agents --skip-hooks, writes the gate scalars, and derives its counts at run time. It writes the beads adapter notes. They hold the bd init consent question and its two flags, bd sync, and the claim read-back. The Dolt-in-git clone smoke check gates E2.
epics.outcome: Beads holds the state of programs, epics, slices, and pull requests, and a second clone sees the same state.

epics.title: Read model: build_index.py, build_builds_view.py, and verify_gate.py read through the port and the projector. The stateful file sections generate from the tracker. The index keeps its shape, and a test checks that every join scalar comes from the envelope. The readers import the port, and they do not read 04-slices.md for state.
epics.outcome: The index, the gate check, and the builds view read state through the port, and the viewer needs no change.

epics.title: Write model: the implement and architect procedures and scripts write state only through the port, and every state write needs a configured adapter. Gate approvals become program scalars. A pull request issue opens at the pull request and a human closes it at the merge. The goal.json epics[] shape drops branch, pr, and state. The skill text lands here: a Workflow state section in the SKILL.md of architect, implement, pr, and artifact. The step procedures name the command.
epics.outcome: Every state write goes through the port, and the four main skills teach the one command.

epics.title: Beads-native features: the beads adapter uses atomic claim (update --claim --if-assignee), native ready with a parity check, a pull request gate, and a slice-loop formula whose failed attempts are wisps squashed to a digest. E5 starts after E4 and needs the engineer's approval of its design.
epics.outcome: The beads adapter claims atomically, answers ready natively, mirrors the pull request block as a gate, and runs the slice loop as a formula.
